name: Drafted Learn
description: Displays an AI/ML fact in your terminal every time you submit a prompt to Claude. Covers 94 facts across 8 categories — tokenization, transformers, RLHF, agent architecture, training data, ethics, and more — rotating randomly so you learn passively while Claude is thinking. Zero extra time required. Built by Drafted Labs for university students entering the AI field.
longDescription:
Ships **1 hook**, `UserPromptSubmit`.

Installs with `claude plugin install drafted-learn@claude-community` from `draftedlabs/drafted-learn`.

Keep learning with hands-on tasks at: joindrafted.com/student

Displays an AI/ML fact in your terminal every time you submit a prompt to Claude. Covers 94 facts across 8 categories — tokenization, transformers, RLHF, agent architecture, training data, ethics, and more — rotating randomly so you learn passively while Claude is thinking. Zero extra time required. Built by Drafted Labs for university students entering the AI field.
